ember.$description: Ember — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

berkeleymono.$description: Universal typeface — headlines, body, nav, buttons, code, table cells, logo. Weight 400 carries prose and UI labels; weight 700 is reserved for emphasis and primary CTAs. The monospaced geometry unifies the brand and signals engineering audience. Every line of text, including navigation and button labels, sits in this monospaced grid — there is no proportional fallback for content.

inter.$description: Secondary text layer — small icon labels, fine print, tertiary annotations where proportional letterforms reduce visual density below the mono baseline
